The '''Nieuth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wyloff sector/Legends|Wyloff sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The system's [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Nieuth Four|Nieuth]], and it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nieuth Four]].
